integrity: All claims are stated with the same hypotheses; the proof is self-contained and the enclosed numerical checker is corroborative, not a formal or independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns only the edge-inequality fractional stable-set relaxation of complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts, in the canonical ambient Euclidean metric. Bibliographic priority is provisional; finite tests do not prove the all-order theorem.
title: Exact Euclidean relaxation gaps for complete multipartite stable-set polytopes
